name: B10-0400/2026 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Cuba to release everyone held only for speaking out or protesting peacefully, including Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro. It asks Cuba to allow free speech and peaceful gatherings, stop harassing activists and journalists, reform its laws, and let independent human rights groups in. It also condemns the United States embargo and sanctions on Cuba and asks for them to be lifted. This is an opinion; the text does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes immediately; the Parliament is asking Cuba and the United States to act.
- It concerns imprisoned protesters and activists, their families, and people in Cuba facing shortages.
- The text is sent to Cuba, the United States and European Union bodies; no deadline is set.
